THE PROJECT, LED BY KANSAS MANUFACTURING SOLUTIONS, IS A SIX-STATE MEP CENTER COLLABORATION THAT WILL DEVELOP AND DEPLOY A HOLISTIC APPROACH TO EMPLOYEE RETENTION APPLYING PRACTICAL APPLICATION OF U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE'S JOB QUALITY TOOLKIT AND BEST PRACTICES FROM AROUND THE MEP NATIONAL NETWORK.ACTIVITIES: THE THREE-PHASE PROJECT INCLUDES PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT TO ANALYZE EXISTING WORKFORCE RETENTION METHODS AND TOOLS AND DETERMINE GAPS, IDENTIFY PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS OF THE EIGHT KEY DRIVERS OF THE JOB QUALITY TOOLKIT, AND CREATE TOOLS SUCH AS ASSESSMENTS, ROADMAPS, AND A BENCHMARKING-CAPABLE DATABASE TO ENHANCE OPERATIONAL PERFORMANCE AND EMPLOYEE DEVELOPMENT. PROJECT DEPLOYMENT TO UTILIZE THE TOOLS IDENTIFIED ABOVE TO ASSESS GAPS AND NEEDS OF INDIVIDUAL SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED MANUFACTURERS (SMMS) IN EACH GEOGRAPHY AND INITIATE INTERVENTIONS/PROJECTS THAT ADDRESS EMPLOYEE RETENTION; PROJECT TYPES WILL VARY BASED ON EACH CENTER'S CAPABILITIES BUT MAY FOCUS ON CULTURE ANALYSES, HR CONSULTING, EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT, EMPLOYEE ONBOARDING, QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS ENHANCEMENTS, SUCCESSION PLANNING, LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT, HIRING BEST PRACTICES, INSTRUCTIONAL DESIGN, COACHING, TEAM BUILDING, EMERGING LEADERS, HANDS-ON SKILLS TRAINING, QUALITY JOBS, TRAUMA-INFORMED APPROACHES TO CULTURE CHANGE, AND PROGRAMS FOR PEOPLE WITH BARRIERS TO EMPLOYMENT IN MANUFACTURING, INCLUDING WOMEN, UNEMPLOYED INDIVIDUALS, UNDEREMPLOYED INDIVIDUALS, JUSTICE-INVOLVED INDIVIDUALS, AND UNDERSERVED COMMUNITIES. EVALUATION/REPORTING/BEST PRACTICE SHARING WHICH WILL INCLUDE NIST/MEIS REPORTING FOR COMPLETED PROJECTS, CONSOLIDATION OF THE TOOLS AND METHODS IDENTIFIED ABOVE INTO A WORKFORCE RETENTION TOOLKIT THAT CAN BE SHARED, ALONG WITH FINDINGS AND SUCCESS STORIES, WITH THE MEP NATIONAL NETWORK THROUGH WEBINARS AND APPLY FOR PRESENTATIONS AT THE NATIONAL MEP CONFERENCE.OUTCOMES: THE EXPECTED OUTCOMES OF THIS PROJECT AIM TO CREATE IMMEDIATE AND LONG-TERM BENEFITS FOR THE MANUFACTURING SECTOR: ECONOMIC IMPACT: 2,000 COMPANIES TOUCHED, 150 COMPANIES SERVED (PROJECTS), AND 2,000 JOBS CREATED/RETAINED. UPSKILLED WORKFORCE: COMPANY LEADERS, MANAGEMENT TEAM, AND EMPLOYEES WILL GAIN NEW SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES, ALIGNING WITH THE DEMANDS OF MODERN MANUFACTURING ENVIRONMENTS.
